chat-thread.name: Chat Thread
chat-thread.purpose: Render a conversational log from governed Chat Message items, preserving empty, loading, offline, error, selected-message, and handoff states.

anatomy.rule: Composes Surface as the structural root and owns log semantics.
Renders ordered Chat Message records without raw message shells.
Composes Empty State for unavailable or first-use states.
Uses Focus and State for selected message review.

chat-thread.statePrecedence: error > offline > loading > handoff > empty > default

Energy.decision: Semantic emphasis and risk are inherited from component or pattern tone contracts.
Energy.behavior: Visible state and action meaning without raw color overrides.
Energy.example: Operational state with success, warning, or danger meaning.
Energy.rejectIf: Raw semantic color replaces Flow energy tokens.

Voice.decision: Labels, helper text, metadata, and recovery copy stay explicit.
Voice.behavior: Users and agents can understand the object without decorative symbols.
Voice.test: Verify readable labels and assistive names.
Voice.rejectIf: Meaning is hidden in placeholder, icon, or color only.

Frame.decision: Spacing, size, wrapping, and responsive fit follow Flow frame tokens.
Frame.behavior: The component fits dense templates without local layout hacks.
Frame.test: Verify no overflow at supported densities.
Frame.rejectIf: Hardcoded frame values bypass component aliases.

Depth.decision: Surface ownership stays with Surface or the composing pattern/template.
Depth.behavior: The component does not create a Card-like structural shell.
Depth.rejectIf: Component wraps itself in Card or local surface chrome.

Momentum.decision: Focus, loading, reveal, and transition behavior use shared motion contracts.
Momentum.behavior: State changes remain predictable and reduced-motion friendly.

State.decision: State precedence is explicit and data attributes remain machine-readable.
State.behavior: Disabled, loading, error, focus, and fallback states do not conflict.
State.test: Verify precedence and DOM state attributes.
State.rejectIf: State is visual-only or uncontrolled by props.

Tone.decision: Tone is expressed through text and semantic props, not decorative color.
Tone.behavior: Risk, success, neutral, and recovery meaning remain understandable.
Tone.test: Verify tone maps to visible message.

Growth.decision: Usage remains observable and can escalate to a pattern or template when scope grows.
Growth.behavior: The component stays atomic and does not own workflow behavior.

Symbol.decision: Symbols may support recognition, but text remains required for meaning and fallback.
Symbol.behavior: Visible text remains the source of truth.
Symbol.example: Icon, avatar, currency, or status marker with label.
Symbol.rejectIf: Symbol replaces the accessible or visible label.

Iconography.decision: Functional icons are delegated to Iconography or child components.
Iconography.behavior: Affordances stay consistent without local glyph systems.
Iconography.test: Verify approved icon names and labels.
Iconography.rejectIf: Local icon system or decorative icon replaces text.

Accessibility.decision: Native semantics, labels, describedby, live regions, focus, and disabled behavior are preserved.
Accessibility.behavior: Assistive tech can operate and recover.
Accessibility.test: Verify label, focus, state, and recovery association.
Accessibility.rejectIf: ARIA or focus behavior is missing.

rejectIf: Thread uses Card as a grouping shell.

productExamples.example: Render a governed conversation log from Chat Message records with empty, loading, offline, error, selected-message, and handoff states.
Used only through governed Flow patterns/templates.

do: Use Chat Thread for a governed conversational log.
Use when messages, availability state, selected message, and message actions must be explicit.
Use below a formal conversational pattern/template that owns composer and routing.
dont: The thread also owns composer, channel routing, or support escalation.
The log must support regulated audit retention.
A template tries to render raw message markup directly.
info: Keep the component atomic and package-owned.

contextDensityStrategy.strategy: Use lg density with stacked controls, visible labels, and touch-safe targets.
Use md density with balanced control rhythm and responsive grouping.
Use sm density only where scanning and operational throughput require compact rows.

agentInstructions: Use Chat Thread for a governed conversational log.

Use below a formal conversational pattern/template that owns composer and routing.
